generation.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original character concept art for Vo Lam Hero Defense, Phase 1 director review only, NOT an animation atlas.
Primary request: Design Thieu Lam (Shaolin), male Buddhist warrior monk, Kim / Gold school, in the project's detailed chibi wuxia PIXEL ART style.
Reference interpretation: the monk in the LOWER HALF of artwork/thieu-lam-thien-son.png is the costume and weapon guide, not the white-robed long-haired Thien Son character above. Existing approved Vo Dang and Thien Son concepts establish finish, expressive faces, layered fabric and elevated camera; Cai Bang runtime artwork establishes compact gameplay silhouette. Reinterpret originally, do not copy any sheet or labels.
Composition: a clean square concept board on a subdued dark slate/blue-gray background. Two clearly separated FULL BODY presentations of exactly the SAME monk at the same scale. Main view on left: unarmed stable guarded stance, both fists and both feet fully visible. Supporting view on right: slight three-quarter turn, holding ONE broad curved single-edged dao in a believable right-hand grip, left hand in guard. Entire blade, hand, head and shoes within generous canvas margins. Small restrained palette swatches at bottom if space permits. No labels, lettering, decorative border, UI or scenery.
Identity: shaved bald head, warm skin, expressive dark eyes and thick disciplined brows, calm focused face; strong shoulders, sturdy forearms, clear hands, compact approximately 2.5-head chibi proportions and broad grounded stance. Practical martial monk, not a huge bodybuilding adult or infant. Show visible top planes of scalp, shoulders and feet in an orthographic elevated three-quarter RPG overworld camera; not an eye-level portrait camera, not isometric, not side-scrolling.
Costume from monk reference: saffron/ochre cross-collar martial tunic with dark brown edging, short loose sleeves leaving wrapped forearms and fists readable, layered split short robe/skirt panels above loose dark warm-brown trousers, simple dark brown waist sash and diagonal cloth fold/strap, restrained dark wooden prayer beads, off-white cloth wrist/shin wraps and sturdy dark cloth shoes. Cloth layers and highlights support punches and broad sword swings. No metal armor, ornate jewelry, cape, hair, beard or giant shoulder pads. Keep exactly the same face, robes, bead arrangement, wraps, sash and body in both poses.
Dao design: substantial broad pale-steel single-edged blade widening gently toward an upswept curved tip, dark spine and bright clean cutting edge, short dark wrapped handle and a simple restrained warm-gold guard/pommel. It must read as the monk reference's broad curved dao rather than Vo Dang's narrow straight double-edged jian, a katana, polearm, staff or axe. No flame or magical blur concealing the blade. One weapon only in supporting pose; main stance entirely unarmed.
Style: high-quality original detailed chibi wuxia pixel illustration, crisp stepped contours and intentional pixel clusters, selective very-dark brown outlines, coherent upper-left soft daylight highlights, warm shaded skin and fabric folds, compact readable shapes. Match the supplied character family's polish and color discipline. Saffron yellow/ochre with brown shadows, warm ivory wraps, restrained gold material highlights for Kim identity. Keep elemental accents in the palette/materials only, no aura, giant VFX, holy halo or spell effects.
Constraints: complete head/hands/feet and entire dao visible, identity consistency across both views, no extra limbs, no floating weapon, no watermark, no photorealism, no 3D render, no vector icons, no crude geometric placeholder or programmatic pixelation. This enlarged concept must suggest a silhouette that can later be redrawn at the approved approximately 44-logical-pixel body scale; do not present it as finished gameplay sprites.
